newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Cemento Argos sees 45 pct drop in Q1 net.
newsitem.headline: Cemento Argos sees 45 pct drop in Q1 net.

text.p: The first quarter net profit of Colombia's Compania de Cemento Argos fell 45 percent over the same period last year to 12.72 billion pesos, the company said in an earnings statement.
It said the drop was largely due to extraordinary gains in the first quarter of 1996 stemming from a large sell-off of stocks and other investments.
However, operating income rose a steep 107 percent from the first quarter of last year, the statement added.
Total assets rose 19 percent, meanwhile, to 1.2 trillion pesos.
